blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.headline: Teen Debaters Take Regional Title With Argument on Plain Language
paras: A team from Westbrook High School **won** the regional debating final on Saturday, **beating** last year’s champions 3–0 on the motion “**This house would require governments to write in plain language**.” Judges **praised** the team’s **clarity** and **composure**.

Captain Aisha Rahman, 17, said the preparation was **not so much memorizing as listening**. “**We rehearsed our rebuttals aloud**,” she said. Coach Daniel Moreau **noted** that the school’s debating club has **doubled in size** since 2022. The team will compete in the national final in April, **subject to funding**.

items.q: Westbrook lost to last year’s champions.
The captain says preparation was mostly memorizing.

items.q: The national final depends on funding.

blocks.body: Reportagens esportivas/escolares dão **placar**, **elogio externo**, **citação** e **próximo passo**. Verbos: *won, beat, praised, noted, said*.
*Beat* (vencer) é irregular: beat-beat-beaten. *Won the final* × *beat the champions*.

items.s: The team ___ the regional final on Saturday. (win)
The club has ___ in size since 2022. (double)

body: **Take the title.** — Conquistar o título.
**Win hands down.** — Vencer com facilidade.
**Neck and neck.** — Cabeça a cabeça.
**Come out on top.** — Sair por cima.
**Pull off a win.** — Arrancar uma vitória.
**Run for one’s money.** — Dar trabalho ao adversário.
**Level the score.** — Empatar.
**Rise through the ranks.** — Subir na hierarquia.
**Stand tall.** — Manter-se de cabeça erguida.
**Make the cut.** — Passar na seleção.
**How did you prepare for the final?** — Como se prepararam para a final?
**Not so much memorizing as listening.** — Menos decorar do que ouvir.
**And what comes next?** — E o que vem depois?

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence school news report on a fictional competition: result, quote, context, next step.
blocks.model: A team from Greenfield Academy won the district science-speaking contest on Friday, beating nine rivals. Judges praised the team’s clarity and humor. “We practised in front of our grandparents,” said captain Leo Park. The club has grown from six to twenty members since last year. The team will compete in the state final in March. It is subject to travel funding.

items.why: **three-nil verdict** = veredito de três a zero.
